tools.name: image_collection_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a bounded JPG, JPEG or PNG collection and report formats, dimensions, EXIF coverage, date coverage, GPS coverage, corruption and directory summaries.

tools.name: image_metadata_extract
tools.description: Extract normalized EXIF, capture time, GPS, camera, orientation and image properties from bounded JPG, JPEG or PNG files into JSON or CSV.

tools.name: image_integrity_check
tools.description: Check image decodability, MIME-signature consistency, truncation, extreme dimensions and nearly blank content without modifying source images.

tools.name: image_duplicate_detect
tools.description: Group exact duplicate and visually similar JPG or PNG images using SHA-256 and bounded perceptual difference hashes; never deletes source files.

tools.name: image_quality_assess
tools.description: Assess bounded field-photo sharpness, exposure, contrast and near-blank ratios as quality indicators, not scientific validity judgments.

tools.name: image_contact_sheet
tools.description: Generate bounded thumbnail contact sheets labeled with filename, capture time and GPS for rapid field-photo review.

tools.name: image_ocr_text
tools.description: Run offline Chinese and English OCR on bounded field photos, returning text, confidence and word bounding boxes with optional JSON output.

tools.name: image_gps_map
tools.description: Extract EXIF GPS from field photos and write GeoJSON points plus an optional static PNG location map.

tools.name: image_spatial_group
tools.description: Assign geotagged field photos to polygons such as stations, plots or administrative areas using an explicit polygon identifier field.

tools.name: image_safe_derivative
tools.description: Create orientation-corrected bounded JPEG or PNG derivatives with optional metadata removal and size reduction while preserving source files.
